name: Reinsurance Group of America, Incorporated
moat_justification: Moderate moat 6/10: a concentrated life/health reinsurance oligopoly where RGA is the leading pure-play, built on decades of biometric data, underwriting expertise, A+ rated balance-sheet capacity and long-duration in-force treaties that switch slowly — against no structural pricing power over mortality/longevity outcomes, capacity competition on large asset-intensive blocks including from PE-backed rivals, structural earnings volatility from biometric shocks and remeasurements, and capital/ratings constraints. Measured returns support a moderate rather than high score: GAAP ROE was 9.93% (FY2023), 6.63% (FY2024) and 8.78% (FY2025) on AOCI-swollen equity in fundamentals.json, while the company's adjusted operating ROE was 17.4% TTM at Q2 2026 — good, but earned in a risk business whose bad years are set by claims experience, not by the franchise.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:capex — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (estimate: EDGAR companyfacts CIK 898174, PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment: FY2022 $25,000,000 (10-K filed 2023-02-24) and YTD Q3 2023 $20,000,000 (10-Q filed 2023-11-03); no FY fact filed for 2023, 2024 or 2025 thereafter); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.8x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier B (18.7%) vs bull-case tier S (30.0%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end
one_liner: Global life/health reinsurer, moat 6/10 — engine prints Tier A on the TTM base (weighted IRR 23.92%, IV@15% $483.37 vs $266.69) but that OCF base capitalizes insurer float/reserve growth, so the final tier is softened to B at low confidence; it clears 15% at ~$483 on engine numbers, with a materially lower true margin of safety.
exit_alert_suppressed_reason: sector model misfit; tier exists only because of a judgment override
tier_override_reason: SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH insurer artifact: the OCF-based OE base capitalizes float/reserve growth (NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE is structural in 2023, 2024 and 2025 — FY2024 OCF $9,370,000,000 vs net income $717,000,000, driven by an $8,811,000,000 increase in future policy benefits and other reinsurance balances from large assumed blocks; FY2025 OCF $4,091,000,000 vs net income $1,182,000,000), so tier-by-numbers A overstates distributable owner's earnings; softened one notch to B, confidence low — same treatment as PFG/HIG/ACGL/WRB, and the TTM bear case also tiers B.
moat_for: Concentrated global life/health reinsurance oligopoly — few scaled rivals (Munich Re, Swiss Re, Hannover Re) and high balance-sheet/rating barriers to entry
Decades of proprietary biometric data and underwriting expertise — the core input for pricing mortality/longevity risk cannot be bought quickly
Long-duration in-force treaties and embedded client relationships — reinsurance programs renew with incumbents and switch slowly
Diversified global platform (U.S./LatAm, Canada, EMEA, Asia Pacific plus financial solutions) — regional and product diversification dampens any single mortality pool
moat_against: No pricing power over biometric outcomes — mortality/longevity experience and assumption updates drive earnings, not RGA's price list
Large asset-intensive blocks are capacity-competed, including by private-equity-backed reinsurers with cheaper asset origination
Earnings volatility is structural — COVID-era mortality, remeasurement gains/losses and investment marks swing GAAP results year to year
Capital and ratings hostage — growth is capped by insurance capital rules and the need to defend the A+ financial strength rating

overrides.source: EDGAR companyfacts CIK 898174, PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment: FY2022 $25,000,000 (10-K filed 2023-02-24) and YTD Q3 2023 $20,000,000 (10-Q filed 2023-11-03); no FY fact filed for 2023, 2024 or 2025 thereafter
